config.budget_reference: same-run iteration600 under the 3000-iteration learning-rate schedule
config.selection: highest validation reward among zero-critical/power and fairness/utilization >= Fixed Rotation overall and in every shortage; earliest iteration tie

inference_convention.primary_adjustment: Bonferroni across two primary comparison claims
inference_convention.shortage_intervals: exploratory pointwise 95%; not additional confirmatory claims

limitations: Synthetic seven-locality, 24-hour decision support; no real electrical-network validation.
Five training runs give limited information about training variability.
Main comparison claims use Bonferroni-adjusted 97.5% intervals; other intervals are exploratory or secondary pointwise 95% intervals.
Primary inference compares the complete constrained PPO system with Fixed Rotation; their action sets and critical-service constraints differ.
Fairness Rule is the behavior-cloning teacher; this focused study does not establish superiority to that rule or isolate learning alone.
An optimizer comparison concerns this causal current-hour constrained optimizer and declared reward/service outcomes, not all optimization methods.
Iteration-zero selections provide no evidence of improvement caused by PPO updates.
Iteration-600 actors are snapshots of the same 3000-iteration schedule, not a separately tuned 600-iteration training recipe.
The additional-training claim requires every selected checkpoint to be after 600.
The validation-selected deployment actor is secondary to the five-run procedure result.
This comparison cannot establish superiority over a full-horizon optimum.
